description: Establishment of 2 x 50MW Wind Power Plants in Mullikulam area, Mannar
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted its approval on 2025-02-10 to invite Requests for Proposals from the prospective private sector developers for the implementation of the 100 MW Mullikulam Wind Farm (50MW x 2) Project on Build, Own-Operate basis with a 20-year operational period, in line with the Government's comprehensive plan to achieve 70% of the country's electricity supply through renewable energy sources by 2030. Accordingly, Requests for Proposals have been invited for the implementation of the said project following the international competitive bidding method, and seven (7) project proponents have submitted their proposals. The proposal made by the Minister of Energy to award the contracts for the establishment of the said two (2) 50 MW wind power facilities to Consortium of Vidullanka PLC & David Pieris Motor Company (Lanka) Limited and WindForce PLC, based on the recommendation submitted by the Cabinet Appointed Negotiating Committee after evaluating the said proposals, was approved by the Cabinet.
